title: A line of a camera's looks file
description: private/evidence/<model>_fw<fw>/looks_<model>_fw<fw>.jsonl, one JSON object per line, append-only: the coverage ledger's one recorded file (docs/decisions/0023). kit/drive.py writes one line per --path, kit/crawl_run.py one per row it opens and one for its lap, kit/prove_run.py one per row, kit/tools/coverage.py --record one per owner's hand check (camkit.coverage.append_look, which refuses a line this schema refuses: look_problems). It is the mapper's own, never published: it names runs, days, kit commits and the hashes of the camera's downloads. It never holds a value: field names and option names as the run itself kept them, and the records that changed by key alone.

t.description: When, as an ISO date and time.

run.description: The run folder in runs/<model>_fw<fw>/ (a hand check: the folder of its start file).

kit.description: The kit's commit (git's short hash): a row the kit could not read is tried again only on a newer one.

mode.description: The mode the menu was in (the page scan's), where known.

path.description: The row's labels from its top row down ([] for a crawl's lap).

option.description: The option chosen, as the camera writes it (a hand check, a prover's axis or table cell).

did.description: open: the row was opened (Right, or the Enter that opens it) and nothing chosen; choose: an Enter after the press that opened it; act; lap: a crawl's whole lap.

screen.description: The kind of screen the opening showed (camkit.screen's: list, notice, fields, unknown ...).

result.description: looked: opened and walked, its diff the lap's (a crawl), never a choice. kit_failed: a failure that comes again until the kit changes (an unknown screen, no response to Right); any other (lost, an error, a walk cut short, a run that did not finish) is not_reached. retract: kit/tools/coverage.py --record --result retract, the latest look of its row, did and option, which then says nothing.

blocker.description: What greyed or refused it, as a rule: a row the kit knows (never its value), equipment, a remote session.

fields.description: Field names and row labels the screen showed (safety.kept_screen's, safety.screen_fields'), never a value.

options.description: A list's option names where the run kept the whole set (never which one was lit).

kit_message.description: Why the kit could not read or reach it, in the kit's words (quoted texts withheld on a private run).

decision.description: The dated owner decision the run went by, if any.

records_changed.description: The records that differed from the start file, by key alone (the camera's volatile records aside).

note.description: A hand check's own words (never a value).
